title: VEGA avionics bay, exploded
description: Concept teardown of VEGA's avionics bay with its skin unwrapped: a RevPi Connect 5 and a changeover relay on a DIN rail, a battery, a USB hub with the GPS and IMU, the CAN IO PLC with its PT shunt board, and a CANmod.temp for the thermocouples. Contents come from the team; sizes, placement and cable routes are illustrative.
